Two narrow vertical strips (dark brown on the left, orange on the right, rows 1-63) read as cliff cut walls beside the ramp, and they end at a dark line at row 63. Below that the ramp texture continues to row 79. Nothing is drawn as a front face of 3 or more rows, so the ramp reads as a top-down slab.

The dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outline is tinted by the neighbouring material, not black. Overall it would sit acceptably next to the references.
